# **Wireframe Documentation**

## **Pickup & Delivery Scheduler**

**![https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-3/8VHZoHy66Xv-q7qEhYnuQFRKDlh4FlQM1jYdbx-09zsOtz34yrChkDROdqvFznpbM57irP9NsjsNFNFvC09EB5Ag7jDufN0R1dUrGi4pdgw?purpose=fullsize\&v=1][image1]**

## **1\. Wireframe Overview**

The wireframe represents **UI screens** required to interact with:

* Order Service APIs  
* Agent Service APIs  
* Scheduler & Monitoring APIs

The wireframe is divided by **user roles**:

* Customer (Order creation & tracking)  
* Delivery Agent (Assignments & availability)  
* Admin (Monitoring & system control)

---

## **2\. Customer Wireframes**

### **2.1 Create Order Screen**

**Purpose:** Create a pickup & delivery request

**UI Components**

* Header: *\_activation*  
* Input Field: Pickup Location  
* Input Field: Delivery Location  
* Dropdown / Input: Priority  
* Hidden Field: user\_id  
* Button: **Create Order**

**API Mapping**

* `POST /api/orders`

---

### **2.2 Order Details Screen**

**Purpose:** View order status and assignment

**UI Components**

* Order ID  
* Pickup Location  
* Delivery Location  
* Current Status  
* Assigned Agent (if available)  
* Last Updated Time

**API Mapping**

* `GET /api/orders/{order_id}`

---

## **3\. Delivery Agent Wireframes**

### **3.1 Agent Registration Screen**

**Purpose:** Register new delivery agent

**UI Components**

* Input Field: Name  
* Input Field: Phone  
* Button: **Register Agent**

**API Mapping**

* `POST /api/agents`

---

### **3.2 Agent Dashboard**

**Purpose:** Manage availability and view assignments

**UI Components**

* Agent Profile Section  
* Availability Toggle (Available / Busy / Offline)  
* Assigned Orders List  
  * Order ID  
  * Pickup → Delivery  
  * Assignment Status

**API Mapping**

* `PUT /api/agents/{agent_id}/availability`  
* `GET /api/agents/{agent_id}`

---

## **4\. Admin Wireframes**

### **4.1 Admin Dashboard**

**Purpose:** System-level monitoring

**UI Components**

* Total Orders Count  
* Active Agents Count  
* Pending Assignments  
* System Health Indicators

---

### **4.2 Event Logs Screen**

**Purpose:** View internal event processing

**UI Components**

* Event ID  
* Event Type  
* Entity ID  
* Timestamp  
* Payload (expandable)

**API Mapping**

* `GET /api/admin/events`

---

### **4.3 System Metrics Screen**

**Purpose:** Monitor system performance

**UI Components**

* Service Name  
* Metric Type  
* Metric Value  
* Recorded Time

**API Mapping**

* `GET /api/admin/metrics`

---

## **5\. Scheduler (Internal / Optional UI)**

### **5.1 Manual Schedule Trigger Screen**

**Purpose:** Trigger scheduler manually (admin/debug)

**UI Components**

* Input Field: Order ID  
* Button: **Trigger Scheduling**

**API Mapping**

* `POST /internal/schedule`

---

## **6\. Wireframe Navigation Flow**

Customer  
Create Order → Order Details

Agent  
Register → Agent Dashboard → Assigned Orders

Admin  
Admin Dashboard  
├── Event Logs  
├── System Metrics  
└── Scheduler Trigger  
---

## **7\. Wireframe → Backend Mapping Summary**

| Screen | API |
| ----- | ----- |
| Create Order | POST /api/orders |
| Order Details | GET /api/orders/{order\_id} |
| Agent Registration | POST /api/agents |
| Agent Availability | PUT /api/agents/{agent\_id}/availability |
| Event Logs | GET /api/admin/events |
| Metrics | GET /api/admin/metrics |
| Trigger Scheduler | POST /internal/schedule |
